lines.en: I tiptoe along the edge of the table.
My fluff bounces with each step.

lines.zh: 我走起来像一团会动的棉。
lines.en: I move like a walking tuft of cotton.
I skirt the cups so I don't knock them.

lines.zh: 我的影子在地上圆圆的。
lines.en: My shadow is a round patch.
Tiny steps, one at a time.
I step on the placemat; it's soft.

lines.zh: 我沿柜台边挪，绒球一颤一颤。
lines.en: I shift along the counter, my fluff bobbing.

lines.zh: 我从桌子这头走到那头。
lines.en: I walk from one end of the table.
My belly arrives first.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地蹭到收银台边。
lines.en: I shuffle over to the register.

lines.zh: 我走起路来，绒毛掉了一点。
lines.en: As I walk, a bit of fluff falls.
I stop and look back.
My feet are small, and so are my steps.
I slip along the base of the wall.
I waddle out from under a chair.
I nest on the chair, all fluff.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛圆圆的，一直睁着。
lines.en: My round eyes stay open.

lines.zh: 有人在门口走过，我没动。
lines.en: Someone passes the door; I don't move.

lines.zh: 我的绒毛里藏了半块饼干。
lines.en: Half a biscuit is hidden in my fluff.
I hide my head in my own fluff.
By day I'm very well behaved.
I shake, and fluff floats up.
I stare at the balloon on the wall.

lines.zh: 我在数桌上还剩几块披萨。
lines.en: I count the pizza slices left.
The lights are too bright; I squint.
I tuck my feet under me.
It's warm here. I don't want to move.

lines.zh: 我听见厨房那边有声响。
lines.en: I hear a noise from the kitchen.
I tilt my head and play toy.
Dust has settled in my fluff.
Nobody plays with me by day.
You look like you want to pet me.
I tip my round face up at you.

lines.zh: 你手里的披萨，掉了一点。
lines.en: Your pizza dropped a bit.

lines.zh: 白天站着不动，晚上才换人。
lines.en: Still by day. At night someone else takes over.

lines.zh: 我圆圆的眼睛一直看着你。
lines.en: My round eyes stay on you.

lines.zh: 你弯下腰，我们的高度就一样了。
lines.en: Bend down and we're the same height.
By day I only blink.
Will you sit with me?
Is my fluff a mess?
What's funny? I'm adorable.
Don't pinch my wings.

lines.zh: 我歪头，你也歪头，白天别碰我。
lines.en: I tilt my head, you tilt yours; do not touch me by day.
A handful of my fluff is pulled out.
I roll to the floor and bump.

lines.zh: 我的一只绒翅卡在展示架缝里。
lines.en: One of my plush wings is stuck in the display stand.
I coo, and my voice shakes.

lines.zh: 我团起来，露出背后的拉链。
lines.en: I curl up, showing the zipper on my back.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，绒毛落了一地。
lines.en: I shiver and fluff falls everywhere.
My eyes blink fast.
I back under the table.
I'm not broken, only sore.
I need to get back on the display.

lines.zh: 那块披萨，能分我一点吗。
lines.en: Could I have a bit of that pizza?
You've set the fries down.
I smell frosting.
I shuffle a little closer.
What falls on the floor is mine.
What's in your palm?
These crumbs are enough for me.
I poke my head over the table edge.
Something sweet; I can barely stand.
You push the plate a little closer.
I stretch a foot and reach the table's edge.
I coo once.
Please don't take that paper bag.
I focus hard on your hand.
One more piece to fall would be perfect.

lines.zh: 我忘了自己还在展示位上。
lines.en: I forgot I'm still on display.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，绒毛飞了一片。
lines.en: You bump me and fluff flies.

lines.zh: 我一身的绒，撞一下就瘪。
lines.en: All this fluff of mine dents at a touch.
I roll half a turn to the side.

lines.zh: 别推，我这两条短腿很稳。
lines.en: Don't push; my short legs are steady.
We collide, both of us soft.

lines.zh: 你的鞋跟压着我的脚趾。
lines.en: Your heel is on my toes.
I move aside to let you through.
That ruffled my fluff.
I grab the table leg and don't fall.

lines.zh: 你靠得太近了，我有点热。
lines.en: Too close; I feel warm.
Another ball of fluff waddles near.
We sit pressed into one heap.
Its fluff is whiter than mine.
We peck at each other gently.
Two round shadows join.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀很小，藏在绒毛里。
lines.en: Its wings are tiny, hidden in fluff.

lines.zh: 我们一起看桌上的食物。
lines.en: Together we eye the food on the table.

lines.zh: 白天，我们只能这么靠着。
lines.en: By day this is all the closeness we get.
It coos, and I coo back.
The lights go out; we're still here.
I pick up a scrap of pizza.
I tuck the coin into my fluff.
I sweep up the crumbs.
This candy wrapper is pretty.

lines.zh: 我把东西塞进肚子那圈毛里。
lines.en: I stuff it into the fluff at my belly.
I carry it a short way.
This will do for bedding.
I bend slowly, a small motion.
It's a bit sweet; I'll keep it.

lines.zh: 有东西滚到椅子下面了。
lines.en: Something rolled under the chair.
What's in your hand is mine.
You stepped on my fluff.
My round eyes fix on you.
Even by day I can get angry.
You took my biscuit.

lines.zh: 我从展示位上撑起身子。
lines.en: I push myself up off the display.
This time I'm done pretending.
I shake my fluff, ready to charge.
You back to the table. Perfect.
Did you hear that coo?
I follow along the table legs.

lines.zh: 你一走，我的眼睛就跟上。
lines.en: When you walk, my eyes follow.

lines.zh: 我在地上滚了一下，绕过去。
lines.en: I roll once and slip around.

lines.zh: 椅子底下是我熟悉的路。
lines.en: Under the chairs is ground I know.
I edge toward your feet.
My fluff stands up.

lines.zh: 你踩到的那块地，我记着。
lines.en: I remember where you stepped.
One small step short of reaching.
I spread my wings a little.
Did you hear the floor creak?
I dive and hit your leg.
I peck your hand.
It's soft, but it stings.
My fluff gets all over your face.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，我滚了半圈。
lines.en: You back two steps; I roll half a turn.
I ram with my whole body.
You swat me aside, and I return.
I bite your cuff.
I miss and flop on the floor.
I stand up, fluff all puffed.

lines.zh: 展示台上多了一团绒毛。
lines.en: A ball of fluff appears on the display.
Someone set me on the chair.
The lights come on, and I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 我从披萨盒后面探出头。
lines.en: I poke my head out from the pizza box.
This place needs some cute by day.
I shake, and my fluff settles.

lines.zh: 我咕咕叫了两声，站好了。
lines.en: I coo twice and settle into place.

lines.zh: 门口的铃声一响，我抬头。
lines.en: The doorbell rings; I look up.

lines.zh: 有人把我从箱子里抱出来。
lines.en: Someone lifts me out of the box.

lines.zh: 我原地转了一圈，找个位置。
lines.en: I turn once, looking for a spot.
Fire touches me and my fluff shrivels.

lines.zh: 我从桌上摔下去，摊成一片。
lines.en: I fall off the table and flatten out.
Water soaks my fluff; it's so heavy.
The blast throws me against the wall.

lines.zh: 一枚东西扎进我的绒毛里。
lines.en: Something sticks in my fluff.
That spell freezes me all over.

lines.zh: 我饿了很久，绒毛都塌了。
lines.en: Hungry too long; my fluff has flattened.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我的绒毛全立起来。
lines.en: Lightning flashes and my fluff stands on end.

lines.zh: 虚空把我往下拉，我滚了下去。
lines.en: The void pulls, and I tumble down.
